# Vectors: payload-guideline

Guideline baseline: `ca8d1c5` · Kind: payload · 45 vectors · [All vector files](README.md)

Golden payload vectors taken from Appendix B (MG B1.1.1, B1.1.2, B1.1.5, B1.1.7, B1.1.8, B1.1.10, B1.1.11, B1.1.12, B1.2.1): topic and message of the Message Bus, including the Birth, Close and Will messages (MG 6.3.3 … 6.3.5, C-025); and the predefined MetaData of the Alliance resources (MG B2.1 … B2.8) as bare DataSetMetaDataType objects. The reference checks cover the envelope of MG 8 (areas MSG and ACT) and, since C-027, the DataSet content of MAM, Health, Profile, PublicationList, ReferenceDesignation and the helper DataSets Pagination, PaginationRequest and Locale (areas RES-MAM … LOC); the remaining resources follow in C-028. A vector that differs from its example keeps the verbatim example in original and lists every change in edits.
